listening-text-2.transcript: Oh, I wish I hadn’t borrowed this camera from Larry. I dropped it, and it doesn’t work now. Let’s go downtown and find someone to fix it. Okay.
listening-text-2.translationZh: 唉，真希望我没向拉里借这台相机。我把它摔了，现在用不了了。咱们进城找人修一修吧。好的。
listening-text-2.summaryZh: 男士把向拉里借来的相机摔坏了，两人决定进城找人修理。

listening-text-3.transcript: Kate, good news. The company I did a field project for offered me a job at a good starting salary. Wonderful, Bill. Let’s have a party this weekend.

listening-text-4.transcript: I can’t decide where to take my mom to dinner for her birthday. Crest Café, or Blue Plate? Crest Café is better. Or you can try King Lee’s. I had dinner there yesterday. It was fantastic. Okay, I’ll try it. Thanks.

listening-text-6.transcript: Oh, dear. I gained five pounds in the last two months. These jeans don’t fit me now. Don’t worry. You still look pretty. But it’s too quick. I think it’s Poplar Street. Gee, you really are lost. The best thing to do is to drive back down Elmer Road until you get to Westin Hospital, and then turn right. Drive back down Elmer Road. Yes. After you turn right at the hospital, Cider Street will be the second street on your right. Got it. Thanks. Hopefully we’ll be there by 7:30.

listening-text-9.transcript: Oh, so slow. Yeah, it’s a long line. People are buying a lot for the holiday. Would you like to go ahead of me? Really? Thank you so much. My husband is waiting outside the store, and we’re in a hurry. I really appreciate it. That’s okay. If you don’t mind, could you pay it forward by doing something kind for someone else? Sure, I’d love to. I will figure out something nice to do on my way back. By the way, I’m doing it for Random Acts of Kindness Week. Could I tell you something about it? Yes, please. It’s initiated by the local church. We do it from Monday to Thursday. On Monday, we encouraged people to smile more. Tuesday’s challenge was to have lunch with someone we don’t normally eat with. Yesterday, we had the third challenge, volunteering. I helped at a nursing home. Today, we do something for someone in need and ask them to pay it forward. That’s great. I love it. How can I join? Here is the website. Just apply online. It’s simple. Okay. I’ll do it now.

listening-text-10.transcript: Good afternoon, everyone. I’m here to offer you some tips on public speaking. One of the worst mistakes you can make as a public speaker is talking too long. It doesn’t matter if your entire speech was good and the audience came away with information that will change their lives. If you talk too long, they will leave saying, 'That speaker just wouldn’t quit.' Don’t let this happen to you. Say what you have to say, and sit down. Before you do, give them a well-thought-out closing. The last thing you say is generally what the audience remembers most. Just like your opening, your closing doesn’t have to be humorous. It could be challenging, thoughtful, or it could retell your point in a different way. Please, at some time during your talk, ask the audience to do something. Many a great talk went no farther than the walls of the meeting room, because the audience wasn’t moved to action. If you haven’t asked them to do something by now, the closing is your last chance.
listening-text-10.translationZh: 大家下午好。我来给大家讲讲公开演讲的几点建议。作为演讲者，最糟糕的错误之一就是讲得太久。哪怕你整场演讲都很精彩，听众带走的信息能改变他们的人生，也无济于事。如果你讲得太久，他们离场时会说：“那个演讲的人就是不肯停。”别让这种事发生在你身上。把要说的说完，然后坐下。在坐下之前，给听众一个精心设计的结尾。你最后说的话，通常是听众记得最牢的。和开场白一样，结尾也不一定要幽默。它可以有挑战性、引人深思，也可以换一种方式重申你的观点。请在演讲中的某个时候，要求听众去做点什么。许多精彩的演讲没能走出会议室的四面墙，就是因为听众没有被打动去行动。如果到这时你还没要求他们做什么，结尾就是你最后的机会。
listening-text-10.summaryZh: 演讲者给出公开演讲的建议：不要讲太久，精心设计结尾，并号召听众行动。

question:listening:1.stemTranslationZh: 女士接下来可能会做什么？

evidence.quote: Can I bring more than one dress to try on?

question:listening:1.reasonZh: 女士问了试衣间在哪，又问能不能多带几条裙子去试（more than one dress to try on），店员说可以，她接下来就去试穿，选 C。

question:listening:2.stemTranslationZh: 男士会怎样处理这台相机？

evidence.quote: Let’s go downtown and find someone to fix it.

question:listening:2.reasonZh: 相机摔坏用不了，接着说进城找人修（find someone to fix it），对方也答应了，“请人修理”就是这件事，选 A。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 拉里是相机的主人，男士是从他那儿借来的（borrowed this camera from Larry），不是要借给他。

question:listening:3.stemTranslationZh: 女士为什么提议开派对？

optionTranslationsZh.B: 比尔找到了一份好工作。

evidence.quote: The company I did a field project for offered me a job at a good starting salary.

question:listening:3.reasonZh: 比尔说那家公司给了他一份起薪不错的工作（offered me a job at a good starting salary），“找到一份好工作”就是这个意思，选 B。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 起薪（starting salary）是新工作一开始的工资，不是原来的工资涨了。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: project 是比尔以前给这家公司做的实地项目（did a field project for），只是交代是哪家公司，好消息是对方给了他工作。

question:listening:4.stemTranslationZh: 女士会去哪里给妈妈庆祝生日？

evidence.quote: Or you can try King Lee’s.

question:listening:4.reasonZh: 男士推荐金李餐厅（King Lee’s），说自己昨天在那吃过、很棒，女士答应去试（I’ll try it），选 C。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 克雷斯特咖啡馆在比较时被认为更好（Crest Café is better），但男士接着又推荐了金李餐厅，女士最后答应去的是后者。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 蓝盘子餐厅只在开头和克雷斯特咖啡馆一起被拿出来比较（Crest Café, or Blue Plate?），后面没人选它。

evidence.quote: Didn’t you know there would be a thunderstorm today?

question:listening:5.reasonZh: 鲍勃浑身湿透，两人说到雷暴（thunderstorm）、阵雨（shower）和倾盆大雨（rain cats and dogs），都围绕天气，选 B。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 公园只是鲍勃去慢跑的地方（jog in the park），两人谈的是他为什么被雨淋透。

distractors.explanationZh: rain cats and dogs 是“下倾盆大雨”，不是鲍勃的猫和狗；录音里的 Bob 只是女士在叫他的名字。

question:listening:6.stemTranslationZh: 两人最可能是什么关系？

evidence.quote: No need, dear.

question:listening:6.reasonZh: 男士夸女士还是很漂亮（You still look pretty），又亲昵地叫她 dear（No need, dear），还清楚她平时吃什么，像丈夫在宽慰妻子，选 B。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 男士虽然解释了长胖的原因、建议她多运动，但他夸她漂亮、叫她 dear，不是医生对病人说话的口气。

evidence.quote: You can just take more exercise and still enjoy those foods.

question:listening:7.reasonZh: “多做运动”就是男士说的多锻炼（take more exercise），他还说那些食物照样可以吃，选 A。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 多喝水是女士说自己平时的习惯（drink plenty of water），不是男士给的建议。

distractors.label: C

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: time 出现在 on time 里，是约书亚说自己没法准时到，他并不是打电话来核对时间。

evidence.quote: I think it’s Poplar Street.

question:listening:9.reasonZh: 约书亚说经过银行后，现在在一条有白色高楼的街上，他认为是白杨街（Poplar Street），选 C。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 赛德街（Cider Street）是玛丽亚指路时说的，医院右转后右手第二条街，他还没开到那里。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 埃尔默路是他十分钟前经过国家银行的那条路（on Elmer Road ten minutes ago），现在已经不在那儿了。

question:listening:10.stemTranslationZh: 约书亚的目的地是哪里？

evidence.quote: I’m sorry we can’t be at your place on time.

question:listening:10.reasonZh: 约书亚对玛丽亚说没法准时到你家（at your place），your place 就是玛丽亚家，玛丽亚给他指的也是去她家的路，选 A。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 国家银行是他十分钟前路过的地方（passed the National Bank），只说明他走到了哪里。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: 韦斯汀医院是指路用的地标，开到医院再右转（until you get to Westin Hospital, and then turn right），不是终点。

question:listening:11.stemTranslationZh: 男士希望每月付多少房租？

evidence.quote: Could it be £800 if I rent it for a longer period of time?

question:listening:11.reasonZh: 广告上的房租是 950 英镑，男士问长租能不能降到 800 英镑（Could it be £800），他想付的是 800 英镑，选 B。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: 950 英镑是广告上的房租（The ad says the rent is £950），男士正是想把它谈到 800 英镑。

evidence.quote: There’s a shopping center right across the street.

question:listening:12.reasonZh: 房东说这地方很方便（really convenient），街对面就是购物中心（a shopping center right across the street），选 A。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 房东自己承认门口有点吵（it’s a little noisy），说不上安静。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: college 确实听到了，但房子离伦敦学院大约八个街区（about eight blocks from the college），要坐公交，不是紧挨着。

evidence.quote: Is it possible for me to drop by and see the flat tomorrow?

question:listening:13.reasonZh: 男士问明天能不能过去看看房子（drop by and see the flat），房东说可以，选 C。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: find 出自房东建议男士找人分摊房租（find someone to share the rent），他明天是去看这套房，不是另找房子。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 租金还要商量（We can talk about it），明天只是去看房，谈不上搬进去。

evidence.quote: My husband is waiting outside the store, and we’re in a hurry.

question:listening:14.reasonZh: 两人在排长队，大家在为过节买东西（buying a lot for the holiday），女士又说丈夫在商店外面等（waiting outside the store），可见他们在商店里，选 B。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: church 是说这项活动由当地教会发起（initiated by the local church），不是两人所在的地方。

question:listening:15.stemTranslationZh: 男士本周的第一个挑战是什么？

evidence.quote: On Monday, we encouraged people to smile more.

question:listening:15.reasonZh: 活动从周一开始（from Monday to Thursday），周一是鼓励人们多微笑（encouraged people to smile more），这就是第一个挑战，选 B。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 做志愿服务是昨天的第三个挑战（the third challenge, volunteering），不是第一个。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: 周二是和平时不一起吃饭的人吃午饭（have lunch with someone），是第二个挑战，也不是请陌生人吃晚饭。

evidence.quote: Yesterday, we had the third challenge, volunteering.

question:listening:16.reasonZh: 周一是第一个挑战，周二是第二个，昨天做的是第三个（Yesterday … the third challenge），昨天是周三，今天就是周四；活动正好做到周四（from Monday to Thursday），选 C。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 星期二（Tuesday’s challenge）是第二个挑战的日子，早已过去。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: 星期三是做第三个挑战的那天，男士说那是昨天（Yesterday），不是今天。

evidence.quote: I’ll do it now.

question:listening:17.reasonZh: 男士给了网址，让她在网上申请（Just apply online），女士说现在就办（I’ll do it now），选 A。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: husband 出自女士说丈夫在商店外面等（My husband is waiting outside the store），她没说要给他打电话。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: pay 出自 pay it forward，意思是把善意传下去，不是付钱；她最后说马上做的是网上申请。

question:listening:18.stemTranslationZh: 根据女士的说法，演讲者应避免做什么？

evidence.quote: One of the worst mistakes you can make as a public speaker is talking too long.

question:listening:18.reasonZh: “说得太多”就是演讲者说的讲得太久（talking too long），她接着又说把要说的说完就坐下（Say what you have to say, and sit down），选 C。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: talking too 确实听到了，但后面是 long，说的是讲太久，不是声音太大。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: speaking 出自 tips on public speaking，指公开演讲；录音说的毛病是讲太久（talking too long），没提语速。

question:listening:19.stemTranslationZh: 为什么演讲的结尾要精心设计？

optionTranslationsZh.A: 它通常是最被记住的部分。
optionTranslationsZh.B: 它是表明观点的最后机会。

evidence.quote: The last thing you say is generally what the audience remembers most.

question:listening:19.reasonZh: 演讲者说最后讲的话通常是听众记得最牢的（what the audience remembers most），和选项说的是同一件事，选 A。

distractors.label: B
distractors.explanationZh: last chance 说的是如果还没请听众行动，结尾就是最后的机会（the closing is your last chance），讲的是号召行动，不是表明观点。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: opening 出自“结尾和开场白一样不必幽默”（Just like your opening … doesn’t have to be humorous），并没有比较两者哪个重要。

question:listening:20.stemTranslationZh: 女士建议演讲者在演讲中做什么？

evidence.quote: Please, at some time during your talk, ask the audience to do something.

question:listening:20.reasonZh: 演讲者要大家在讲话中请听众去做点什么（ask the audience to do something），又说听众没被打动去行动（wasn’t moved to action），演讲就走不出会议室，“激励听众去行动”概括了这两句，选 B。

distractors.label: A
distractors.explanationZh: 录音说结尾和开场白一样不一定要幽默（doesn’t have to be humorous），没有建议表现幽默感。

distractors.label: C
distractors.explanationZh: challenging 是说结尾可以有挑战性（It could be challenging），讲的是结尾的写法，不是让演讲者勇敢迎接挑战。
